result.finding: Single custom bridge network 'photoalbum-network' defined in docker-compose.yml. Both services (oracle-db and photoalbum-java-app) share this network enabling inter-service communication by service name. Port 8080 exposed to host for application access; port 1521 exposed to host for database access.
evidence: docker-compose.yml: top-level networks definition: photoalbum-network with driver: bridge
oracle-db service: connected to photoalbum-network, port 1521:1521 exposed to host
photoalbum-java-app service: connected to photoalbum-network, port 8080:8080 exposed to host
Application connects to DB via hostname 'oracle-db' (Docker DNS resolution within photoalbum-network)
values: Inter-service DNS: oracle-db hostname resolves within photoalbum-network
